fresh_findings.title: Admit scope identity and configuration values once
fresh_findings.evidence: Actual coverage returned A+ for a strict scope after a second scope reused its name with target 100 and coverage exemption. Quoted false also became true. Admission now rejects both before scoring.

fresh_findings.title: Preserve distinct functions that start on the same line
before: Rows keyed by name and line
Queue, marks and packets select the wrong function
after: Rows carry occurrence through SQLite and exports
Canonical keys and printed handles use complete positions
fresh_findings.evidence: Real TypeScript callbacks retain distinct occurrences through exports and stored rows. Queue claims, brief, release and hook tests preserve those identities. Measured functions sharing an identical line span refuse separately; numeric selectors list distinct handles. Old exports remain readable with occurrence 0.

fresh_findings.title: Require proof before reusing legacy debt identities
after: Separate metric and key format versions
Check current and historical collision groups
Refuse uncertain mapping before writing marks or audit records
fresh_findings.evidence: CLI seed, rescore, verify and staged hook regressions preserve mark bytes on refusal. Override checks identity before recording any grant. Legacy claims reserve their entire raw-name group. Migration requires reviewing old source and carrying only approved values. Reader-version admission also refuses anonymous marks from pre-10 or unproved JavaScript-family analysis, even without a same-start collision; old-snapshot claims hold the entire raw-name group.

fresh_findings.title: Parse expression arrows at their actual source spans
before: Functions disappear or inherit a sibling body
Identity and complexity use the wrong records
after: Commas close the correct arrow body
Unresolved TypeScript angle syntax refuses with a remedy
fresh_findings.evidence: 39 targeted tests and the upstream JavaScript, TypeScript and TSX fixtures exercise extraction. Analysis version 10 invalidates old metric evidence. Parenthesizing an ambiguous expression or using a block body resolves the documented TypeScript limit.

fresh_findings.title: Refuse coverage that cannot distinguish sibling functions
before: Distinct functions share one line span
Coverage projection contains no column identity
fresh_findings.evidence: A real CLI regression prevents a false passing score. Equal hits, different hits and a single matching coverage candidate all refuse. Copies across scopes and unmeasured or complexity-only rows preserve their existing behavior.

fresh_findings.title: Apply identity admission to explain and edit advice
before: Explain and edit advisory read raw marks
Another caller attaches an old exemption to a new function
after: Explain supplies full file positions and store history
Advisory checks the edited file's current records
Unproved advisory marks grant no exemption
fresh_findings.evidence: Five public seam regressions cover the missed readers. The advisory opens no snapshot store and writes no key marker. Advisory and explain integration passed 53 tests with two opt-in latency checks skipped.

fresh_findings.title: Give a root scope ownership of loose repository files
before: Loose source files disappear from inventory
after: Normalize dot to the root prefix
Inventory and coverage include root files
fresh_findings.evidence: 25 ownership and CLI checks verify the root case, nested overrides and existing patterns. The configuration reference now states the actual root ownership rule.

fresh_findings.title: Reject nonfinite coverage numbers before scoring
before: Default JSON decoder accepts NaN and Infinity
after: All coverage projections reject nonfinite numbers
Finite values and byte digests stay unchanged
fresh_findings.evidence: Read-to-score tests reproduce NaN, Infinity, -Infinity and exponent overflow. Coverage, missing-line and selected-context projections refuse at admission. The shared admission batch went from 37 failures and one pass to 307 passing checks.

fresh_findings.title: Retain evidence of historical identity collisions
before: Pruning removes the only collision witness
The same seed silently changes ordinal meaning
after: Store selects one recent witness per group
fresh_findings.evidence: Public CLI regressions preserve collision evidence through repeated pruning. Red retention tests are paired with 19 current-root/retention checks and 59 affected e2e passes. One retained run can witness several groups; keep count remains a floor.

fresh_findings.title: Limit pruning to the history it actually inspected
before: Another process records a new run
after: Later coverage and failed-verify runs survive
fresh_findings.evidence: A real second Python process writes coverage or a failed verify between history selection and deletion. Both cases now survive. The fix adds no long write lock and does not claim to serialize updates to older runs.

fresh_findings.title: Preserve mark and claim ownership across reader upgrades
before: Reader 10 recovers a callback at line 3
Old ordinal 2 attaches to the recovered sibling
after: Unproved anonymous marks refuse before writes
Unproved claims reserve their raw-name group
fresh_findings.evidence: Seed, old-snapshot seed, direct override and claim regressions preserve bytes and ownership without remapping debt. The repair passed 196 focused checks; all 13 new cases plus the competition test passed. An older e2e fixture failed on message precedence; its current-proof rerun passed all three cases. Named marks and other languages keep compatible reseed behavior.

fresh_findings.evidence: Actual nested repositories now pass with one and two workers, including dirty parent inputs, deletions and untracked files. Root mutation integration:86 passed.

before: Syntax error counts as a kill

fresh_findings.title: Preserve the configured Windows command

Protected delayed transport for multiline args
Original shell text and argv preserved
fresh_findings.evidence: Real cmd.exe tests cover static variables, bang paths, pipes, chained commands, metacharacters and distinct empty-list/empty-string cases. Multiline arguments combined with static percent expansion explicitly refuse.

after: Read all positions once per file

fresh_findings.title: Publish churn cache bytes under their own identity
before: Concurrent builders share a temporary path
One operation reads another operation's bytes
A cache entry carries the wrong key and data
after: Each operation owns a temporary file
Atomic replacement publishes one complete entry
fresh_findings.evidence: Publication regressions force interleaving and confirm the returned cache belongs to the requesting operation. Invalid or interrupted cache writes remain disposable misses.

fresh_findings.title: Keep ratchet history values and audit keys exact
before: Override audit names a raw function instead of its canonical key
after: History updates values while preserving entry age
Override audit records the exact admitted key

fresh_findings.title: Frame the doctor interpreter probe and control its encoding
before: Startup stderr joins a version response
Windows encoding differs from the decoder
Doctor reports a foreign or damaged interpreter path
after: Bounded process owner captures and cleans up the child tree
fresh_findings.evidence: A real startup warning and a real virtual environment under Jose with an accented e reproduced both defects. The replay confirms exact interpreter paths and ignores startup warnings when decoding the framed response.

fresh_findings.title: Include typed reader mode in analysis-cache identity
before: JSX and TSX share one reader class

after: One predicate owns typed syntax mode
fresh_findings.evidence: The public cold/warm replay accepts JSX, refuses cold TSX, and formerly accepted warm TSX. The paired admission tests now refuse both TSX paths. The shared 307-test green run also preserves same-mode rename hits.
